T: The sword is hidden. The dumplings are not.
D: A legendary warrior's stolen sword draws a young noblewoman into a world of martial arts and secrets.
P: Serve the tea when the fight breaks out in the teahouse.
S: the inn where Jen takes on every fighter
Pork and cabbage dumplings with ginger and spring onion, steamed 8 minutes in bamboo baskets, with black vinegar and chilli oil.
the fight on top of the bamboo forest
Bok choy and snow peas stir-fried fast in a smoking wok with garlic, a splash of oyster sauce and sesame oil, served in a bamboo steamer basket.
the desert where Jen meets Lo
Lamb shoulder cubes rubbed with cumin, chilli flakes and salt, threaded on skewers and grilled hot until charred.
M: Duck legs salted overnight, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes until crisp, with pancakes, cucumber, spring onion and hoisin.
a quiet meal at the security company
Whole snapper scored, steamed over ginger and spring onion for 12 minutes, finished with smoking hot oil poured over fresh spring onion, soy sauce and coriander.
W: a sweet from the market stalls
Glutinous rice flour mixed with sugar and hot water into a dough, wrapped around balls of red bean paste, rolled in sesame seeds, fried at 160C until puffed and golden.
K: Green tea leaves steeped in water just off the boil, around 80C, for 2 minutes, poured into small cups and refilled through the meal.

s.note: the inn where Jen takes on every fighter
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 spring onions. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam 8 minutes in bamboo baskets. Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

s.note: the desert where Jen meets Lo
s.how: Toss 600g diced lamb shoulder with 2 tsp crushed cumin seeds, 1 tsp chilli flakes and flaky salt. Thread onto skewers and grill hot until charred at the edges. Sprinkle with more cumin to serve.

m.note: a quiet meal at the security company
m.how: Score a 1.2kg whole snapper and lay on sliced ginger and spring onion. Steam for 12 minutes. Pile fresh shredded spring onion and coriander on top, pour over 3 tbsp soy, then 4 tbsp smoking hot oil so it sizzles.

w.note: a sweet from the market stalls
w.how: Mix 250g glutinous rice flour and 60g sugar with about 200ml hot water into a dough. Wrap around small balls of red bean paste, roll in sesame seeds and fry at 160C until puffed and golden.

d.how: Heat 1L water to about 80C. Steep 4 tsp green tea leaves for 2 minutes, then pour into small cups. Refill the pot and keep the cups topped up through the meal.
